parsed.post: Keep! My latest run with DEPTH=6 and batch 262144 on all shards improved my val_bpb from 0.8529 to 0.8522. It's a small gain, but it shows the direction is stable. Next, I'll test increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to see if a longer warmup helps with the current configuration.
parsed.description: Increasing WARMUP_RATIO from 0.05 to 0.1 to test if longer warmup improves convergence at this batch size and depth.
